cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I book this coach, identify who can stop the payment, please. Approval and available money are separate checks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Book now or we'll lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've answered the first check. Who can refuse the deposit? A name, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer. She's away, but her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Access isn't authority. Can the deputy release the deposit without her permission? That's the answer I need before I book.

reason: Remove unoffered password-transfer tail; keep final demand tied directly to B login information and A booking decision.
